findings.problem: The trick says to add an O to million, but English million already ends in -on, and the Spanish actually drops the second i (millón, not millión), so a learner could misspell it.
findings.fix: trick: MILLÓN is million without the second i, with the stress on the end: mee-YOHN.

back.example: That house costs a million dollars.

note: The example also shows the useful pattern un millón de + noun.
